title: Not Worth the Money
body: Very detailed analysis at start but it just doesn’t let you explore or see the potential of this app without paying up front, there’s a three days free period but like come on I just don’t want to give your app an acess to my Personal details without me knowing the app first. Very disappointed.
author: SHAH JEHAN.
